user.title: Set up Shopee Xpress
user.description: Shopee Xpress runs a separate service per market — a tracking code from one does not resolve on another's. Pick the market this hub is for; add another hub later for a second market. You'll add parcels after setup.

data_description.add: Enter a tracking code for this hub's market. You find it on the Shopee order page or the shipping confirmation.

data_description.delivered_filter_type: Show delivered parcels from the last X days, or limit to the X most recent.
data_description.delivered_filter_amount: Number of days or parcels to show.

data_description.include_history: Add a per-parcel history attribute listing each status update (timestamp, status, original text). Off by default.

error.already_tracked: That parcel is already being tracked.

track_parcel.name: Track parcel
track_parcel.description: Start tracking a parcel by its Shopee Xpress tracking code.

market.name: Market
market.description: Which market's hub to add it to. Only needed when more than one hub is set up.

untrack_parcel.name: Untrack parcel
untrack_parcel.description: Stop tracking a parcel by its Shopee Xpress tracking code.

tracking_code.name: Tracking code
tracking_code.description: The Shopee Xpress tracking code to stop tracking.

trigger_type.parcel_delivery_time_changed: A parcel's expected delivery time changed
